name: x-human
description: Strip the machine fingerprint out of any draft - em dashes, AI slop words, invisible watermark characters, thread boilerplate - and score it against a five-check detection panel before it goes out. Use whenever text needs to sound human, when the user says humanize, "does this sound like AI", "remove the em dashes", "de-slop this", "this sounds like ChatGPT", or before any post, thread, reply or DM from this pack is shown to the user.

findings.excerpt: python3 humanize.py draft.txt --report        # clean it, show what changed
